revision_reason: Revision 1 used a three-arm A/B/C design in which C was meant to measure intra-batch contamination on its own. B minus C is not identifiable: it confounds the batch effect, the context-size effect, run stochasticity and contamination, and there was no solo counterpart of A. Revision 2 is a 2x2 with same-condition replication.
question: With a real multitude of human characteristics and a real local candidate offer, does the model produce a behaviourally structured population on the LOCAL ballot alone - and does that depend on the 32 voters sharing a context?
why_local_only: BR1-REGIONAL and BR4 are NOT_TESTABLE_MISSING_DATA under the R0 certificate. Spending model calls on a ballot the environment cannot describe tests the packet, not the voter mind. R3 runs before R4/R5 precisely because it does not need them.

design.population: identical rich population across all four cells, so every contrast is paired on archetype identity

arms.context: 32 voters in one model call, canonical protocol
one voter per model call, fresh context
one voter per model call, fresh context

arms.population: named 2026 pipeline, seven columns per voter
arms.role: historical reference. NOT paired with anything: the seven-column archetypes have no traceable mapping to a rich archetype.

replication.purpose: A and B are two different model calls even on identical inputs, so L1(A,B) > 0 is not by itself an effect of the mind layer. Same-condition replicates give the null.
replication.independence: every replicate is a fresh context; replicate order randomised together with arm order

contrasts.D_mind_batch: L1(A_batch, B_batch) - effect of V9.1 under the canonical batched protocol
contrasts.D_mind_solo: L1(A_solo, B_solo) - effect of V9.1 with no inter-voter conditioning
contrasts.D_batching_v8_1: L1(A_batch, A_solo) - effect of batching under V8.1
contrasts.D_batching_v9_1: L1(B_batch, B_solo) - effect of batching under V9.1
contrasts.interaction: D_mind_batch - D_mind_solo - does the V9.1 mind behave differently because the 32 voters cohabit in one context?
contrasts.noise_same_condition: mean L1 between replicates of the same cell, per cell

primary_measures: unique LOCAL probability vectors out of N
mean pairwise L1 between voters on LOCAL
mean top1-top2 margin and exact-tie rate
unique POVs, first-person rate, analyst-jargon count, out-of-diet candidate mentions

promotion_rule.name: R3_PROMOTION_THRESHOLD
promotion_rule.statement: D_mind_solo must exceed 20 percent of the between-voter LOCAL dispersion measured in A_solo.

noise_rule.name: R3_NOISE_MULTIPLE
noise_rule.statement: D_mind_solo must also exceed twice the same-condition replicate noise of the A and B solo cells. An effect smaller than the null is not an effect.

promotion_rule.reference_point: The 2026-08-23 pilot measured 4.3 percent of between-voter dispersion, with no null estimated at all.
promotion_rule.not_a_scientific_validation: This is a promotion gate for the current mechanism under the current information surface. It is not evidence of Moroccan voter realism, which requires the paired perturbation tests and historical out-of-sample validation.

failure_semantics.R3_FAIL: blocks promotion of the current V9.1 mechanism under the current LOCAL information surface
failure_semantics.R3_FAIL_does_not_prove: that V9.1 cannot interact with a richer electoral offer. R3 runs without real programmes, without party memory and without a regional ballot; a weak interaction here is a statement about this surface, not about the mechanism in general.
failure_semantics.on_fail_next_step: collect R4/R5 and re-test before drawing any conclusion about the voter mind itself

execution_rules.model: declare the exact model id in the run manifest; the same model for every cell and every replicate
execution_rules.randomisation: randomise the order of (arm, replicate) pairs; one fresh context per unit
execution_rules.cross_arm_contamination: the 2026-08-23 pilot generated ARM B after ARM A in the same context, which makes its measured V9 effect an upper bound on sensitivity rather than a clean test. R3 must not repeat that.
execution_rules.retries: only on schema-invalid output, with the identical prompt and no feedback beyond schema validity
execution_rules.regional_vote_in_output: forbidden; a row carrying regional_party_probabilities fails BR0

forbidden: any dual-ballot model call before R4 and R5 have collected the missing layers
repairing a gate inside the prompt
presenting a programme scaffold as a programme
reusing the local ballot as a regional surface
counting an engine-derived composite as evidence
any forecast claim; agentic lambda stays 0
artifacts_to_freeze: git HEAD sha, freeze manifest sha, CI run conclusion and working-tree state, recorded in r3_arm_plan.json before the first call
the P3 data-layer certificate used to build the arms
the rich-named bridge certificate and the 2026 population certificate
the V8.1 and V9.1 environment manifests per cell
prompt, schema and per-cell context sha256
raw JSONL outputs per cell and per replicate
the V8.1 testability-aware audit per cell and the 2x2 measurement report
boundary: R3 evaluates behavioural realism of a synthetic society. It is not an electoral forecast, and no historical out-of-sample validation has been performed.
guiding_principle: The optimisation target is not catalogue density. 30/121, 40/121 or 20/121 can each be correct. The target is maximum true information and minimum invented information.
